Vercel Preview deployment isolation is NOT the same as an isolated staging database or separate DB roles.

No real-money auction, seller payout, or authoritative bid enabled by this audit.

liveReadOnlyFindings.finding: A separate data-less Supabase branch enchev-staging (jranctnafndbqzrwcwos) exists and is FUNCTIONS_DEPLOYED: 28 public RLS-enabled tables, 28 parent migrations and 1 staging-only repair, zero auction/bid/early-access rows. Initial automatic migration #24 failed because sfcal_day_view(text,date) was absent from replayed base schema; its and sfcal_day_set_status definitions were restored from live schema to staging only with PUBLIC/anon/authenticated EXECUTE revoked; branch rebase then completed.

Vercel Preview binding still denied (403), so do not route app fixtures to production or treat this as runtime staging.
